name: DashCore
description: DashCore 0.9.8-alpha: reports why each eligible object is retained or culled, with nearest guard-band candidate diagnostics after a 600+120-frame sample.

general-enable.name: General Enable
general-enable.description: Master switch for DashCore. When disabled, the mod stays loaded in Geode but bypasses its hooks, profiling, diagnostics, and automatic last-level loading.

experimental-render-culling.name: Experimental static-object culling (alpha)
experimental-render-culling.description: Opt-in Bismuth-inspired CPU visibility culling for ordinary static objects outside an expanded viewport. Triggers, effects, grouped objects, rotating objects and invalid bounds remain visible. Restart Geometry Dash after changing this setting. Experimental; keep OFF if you notice missing objects or visual changes.

load-last-level.name: Load last played level on startup
load-last-level.description: Automatically opens the last supported standard level after the main menu loads. If it cannot be found, the main menu remains available.

diagnostics-enable.name: Performance Diagnostics
diagnostics-enable.description: Enables the 600-frame timing sample, scene-graph scans and one-time GLES probes. When OFF, high-frequency diagnostic hooks remain registered but auto-disabled, avoiding their per-frame/per-node detour overhead. Turn ON only when collecting a Geode log.
